name: Shinobi Samurai
source:
Konoe Kino, a town pawnbroker's daughter, catches a cold and tries to take medicine, but...
the medicine she takes is a "time capsule" that was being sold at pawn shops.
When she drinks it, she travels back in time to the present day!
There she meets a wonderful man named Kazama, but the story ends up as a dream at the best part of the story.
Then two ninja who are after the "time capsule" appear, along with a samurai who helps her...
This is a story of friendship and love between a ninja and a samurai!
